text: Yes, city staff and assistant legal counsel were requested to draft a proposed ordinance amendment that would authorize and allow a limited number of adult use marijuana establishments in the city pursuant to the Michigan Regulation and Taxation of Marijuana Act as amended and the Marijuana Regulatory Agency Adult Use Marijuana Establishments Emergency Rules. The proposed Adult Use Marijuana Establishment Ordinance is substantially similar to the existing Medical Marijuana Facilities Ordinance. Because the MRTMA and the administrative rules provide that a licensee can be simultaneously licensed for both medical marijuana facilities and adult use establishments, which can all be located in the same location, the proposed Adult Use Marijuana Establishment Ordinance would authorize the two existing locations that have been approved for medical marijuana facilities to also include adult use marijuana establishments consisting of an adult use stacked class C grower, processor and retailer to be vertically integrated at those same approved medical locations. This proposed amendment would also include the adding of one additional vertically integrated medical and adult use marijuana location in the city, identical to the two existing adult and medical marijuana uses. Thus the proposed Adult Use Marijuana Establishment Ordinance if approved by council would result in a total of three fully vertically integrated medical and adult use locations in the city, which would consist of the two already approved existing locations and one additional location that would have all co-located vertically integrated and stacked class C grow operations at all three locations. The potential third location would not be added until sometime in the future upon an appropriate resolution by city council to implement a new application period. This proposed ordinance is supported by the fact that under state law for the first two years, an MRA can only accept applications for adult use marijuana retailers, marijuana processors, class B marijuana growers, class C marijuana growers. Thus only these entities that are already licensed for medical marijuana facilities can apply to the state for the first two years. Should the majority of city council desire to approve these proposed Adult Use Marijuana Established Ordinance, then the appropriate action would be to adopt ordinance 2159 at the first reading and schedule a second reading for the proposed ordinance for June the 22nd, 2020.
